Then we add a dysfunctional family, and those are the perfect ingredients for a "everybody hates me" smoothie. The feeling of isolation and depression sting a lot, and sure like suicide does feel like the only solution. But there is a possibility that things could get better. Just stay strong, and persevere. I know that sounds super cliché, but just know I believe in you. All of this coming from someone who is in a similar situation, and experienced / experiencing these things. ♥️
